t: Four pairs covering a whole life
a: اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَأَخَّرْتُ وَأَسْرَرْتُ وَأَعْلَنْتُ أَنْتَ إِلَهِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
p: Ighfir lī mā qaddamtu wa akhkhartu wa asrartu wa aʿlantu. Anta ilāhī lā ilāha illā ant
m: Forgive me what I have sent ahead and what I have left behind, what I hid and what I made public. You are my God. There is no god but You.
